record.one_liner: Commerce platform for online stores, POS and retail; exposes Admin GraphQL, Storefront, Partner and Customer Account APIs.
record.auth_notes: Admin API is called with an access token in X-Shopify-Access-Token, obtained usually via OAuth token exchange. Client ID and secret come from the app's Settings page in the Dev Dashboard; a client_credentials grant also exists for same-organization stores (tokens expire, no refresh token). Storefront API uses its own public/private tokens.
record.access_notes: Custom apps are created in the Dev Dashboard and tested on development stores before live deployment. The fetched pages did not state the development store price, so the 'free' classification is medium confidence.
record.api_notes: Admin GraphQL API plus Storefront, Partner and Customer Account APIs are documented. REST Admin API and full object coverage were not verified in fetched pages.
record.blocker_notes: Public-app distribution across many merchants goes through Shopify's app review; custom apps per store do not, so a multi-merchant toolkit would need review.
